boards.school_name: State University of New York at New Paltz
boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain State University of New York at New Paltz
boards.description: Ten food-focused New Paltz destinations with publicly listed evening or late-night service; confirm the day’s hours before heading out.

cards.title: Gourmet Pizza
cards.subtitle: 68 Main Street, New Paltz
cards.notes: Use the Main Street location for a late pickup or delivery order. Its posted closing time reaches midnight or later every day it is open.
cards.short_summary: A pizza counter with the latest posted food hours in the village.
cards.evidence_claim: Gourmet Pizza lists hours through midnight Sunday and Wednesday–Thursday, 2 a.m. Tuesday, and 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: Tue until 2 a.m.; Wed–Thu and Sun until midnight; Fri–Sat until 4 a.m. Closed Monday.

cards.title: Moonburger
cards.subtitle: 87 Main Street, New Paltz
cards.notes: Plan this Main Street counter-service stop for Friday or Saturday, when the location lists service until 2 a.m. Pickup and delivery are available.
cards.short_summary: A counter-service burger stop with weekend service until 2 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Moonburger’s New Paltz location lists Friday and Saturday hours from noon to 2 a.m. and identifies counter service, pickup, and delivery.
cards.access_notes: Posted Friday–Saturday hours: noon–2 a.m.; Sunday–Thursday: noon–10 p.m.

cards.title: Taco Bell at 238 Main Street
cards.subtitle: 238 Main Street, New Paltz
cards.notes: For a late drive-thru order, use the Main Street location. The official listing posts midnight weeknight service and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday service.
cards.short_summary: A chain option with posted drive-thru service past midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours until midnight Sunday–Thursday and until 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday at 238 Main Street.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell® in New Paltz, NY - 238 Main St
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is posted until midnight Sun–Thu and 1 a.m. Fri–Sat. Dine-in hours end earlier; use the drive-thru late.

cards.title: Main Street Bistro
cards.subtitle: 59 Main Street, New Paltz
cards.notes: Check the late-night and sushi menu schedule before walking over. The restaurant lists Tuesday–Saturday late-night service ending at midnight.
cards.short_summary: A downtown restaurant whose late-night menu runs until midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Main Street Bistro lists a Late Night & Sushi Menu from 4 p.m. to midnight Tuesday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Late Night & Sushi Menu is posted Tue–Sat, 4 p.m.–midnight; closed Sunday and Monday for that menu.

cards.title: Apizza!
cards.subtitle: 121 Main Street, New Paltz
cards.notes: Use the posted seasonal schedule to time an evening pizza order. Online ordering may be limited during dinner service, so check before relying on it.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street coal-oven pizza restaurant open to 10 p.m. on scheduled days.
cards.evidence_claim: Apizza! lists seasonal hours ending at 10 p.m. Sunday, Monday, and Thursday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Seasonal posted hours end at 10 p.m.; closed Tuesday and Wednesday. The site advises that online ordering is limited during dinner hours.

cards.title: RŪNA
cards.subtitle: 10 Plattekill Avenue, New Paltz
cards.notes: Reserve or call ahead for a Friday or Saturday evening meal. The restaurant’s site lists its dinner service until 10 p.m., with an earlier kitchen close.
cards.short_summary: A Plattekill Avenue dinner destination with Friday and Saturday evening service.
cards.evidence_claim: RŪNA lists Friday and Saturday hours from 5:30 p.m. to 10 p.m., noting that the kitchen closes at 9 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Friday–Saturday dining is posted 5:30–10 p.m.; kitchen closes at 9 p.m. Reservations can be confirmed through the restaurant.

cards.title: New Paltz Indian Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 1 North Manheim Boulevard, New Paltz
cards.notes: Choose this option for a sit-down or takeout dinner before its listed 10 p.m. close. The official contact page notes that Thursday is closed.
cards.short_summary: An Indian restaurant with posted service until 10 p.m. most days.
cards.evidence_claim: New Paltz Indian Restaurant lists hours of 11:30 a.m. to 10 p.m. Monday–Wednesday and Friday–Sunday, with Thursday closed.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours run until 10 p.m. Monday–Wednesday and Friday–Sunday; Thursday is listed as closed.

cards.title: Tokyo Sushi
cards.subtitle: 117 Main Street, New Paltz
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s public page to confirm the evening schedule before going. Current listings identify the Main Street restaurant and its official social presence.
cards.short_summary: A named Main Street sushi and steakhouse destination for evening dining.
cards.evidence_claim: Tokyo Sushi’s public business listing identifies the restaurant at 117 Main Street and links to its official Facebook page; listed service runs to 10 p.m. or 10:30 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Publicly listed hours are until 10 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and 10:30 p.m. Friday–Saturday; verify on the restaurant’s page before travel.

cards.title: Rocco's Pizzeria
cards.subtitle: 4 New Paltz Plaza, New Paltz
cards.notes: Use the plaza location for dinner pickup or delivery. Posted Friday and Saturday hours extend to 9:30 p.m.; review the day-specific schedule before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A New Paltz Plaza pizzeria with Friday and Saturday service to 9:30 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Rocco’s Pizzeria lists Friday and Saturday hours from 11 a.m. to 9:30 p.m. at 4 New Paltz Plaza.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: Friday–Saturday until 9:30 p.m.; other days end between 8 and 9 p.m.

cards.title: Los Jalapenos
cards.subtitle: 25 North Chestnut Street, New Paltz
cards.notes: For an evening meal near campus, use the restaurant’s carryout ordering page and allow time before its posted close. It describes the venue as good for kids.
cards.short_summary: A family-friendly Mexican restaurant open until 9 p.m. daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Los Jalapenos lists daily business hours from 11 a.m. to 9 p.m. and identifies itself as good for kids.
cards.access_notes: Business hours are posted daily until 9 p.m.; carryout ordering ends at 8:30 p.m.
